summary: Incoming members sit through successive leadership ballots before anyone can administer their oath.
realLife: The House members elected in 2022 waited through four days of voting for Speaker before taking office.
inGame: needs: successive Speaker ballots and an oath date for incoming members.

turns.what: The clerk calls the members forward for the oath on opening day.
turns.pulledBy: A candidate wins the first leadership ballot.
turns.writesBack: Members begin their terms' floor business that day.

turns.what: The members elect a Speaker just before adjournment and return for the oath.
turns.pulledBy: The leadership ballot ends as the session breaks.
turns.writesBack: The Speaker election and group oath fall on different days.
